product_name: Motorola Voice C42 Corded Phone System + 1 Digital Cordless Handset w/Answering Machine, Call Block - Black (C4201)
description: Corded + Cordless Phone - C4201 is a black corded phone system with ergonomic cordless handset ideal for both office spaces and home use Hands-Free Conversations - Phone combo features a speakerphone on both so you can take calls without a handset and multi-task while in meetings or talking with friends Multiple Contact Phonebook - Telephone system holds up to 50 entries and includes convenient built-in answering machine to take messages when you're unavailable Phone Intercom System - Phone offers 3-way conferencing with simultaneous intercom and features an easy-to-read bright blue LED display Includes - One (1) corded phone and one (1) cordless handset with base, two (2) batteries, two (2) power adapters, setup guide
